# BoatRent Cyprus

> BoatRent Cyprus is an online marketplace for renting yachts, catamarans, sailing boats, speedboats and fishing boats across Cyprus. Customers browse vessels by coastal town, send a free no-obligation inquiry for the boat they like, and the platform coordinates availability with licensed local operators. Charters are available crewed or self-drive, departing from Limassol, Paphos, Larnaca, Ayia Napa, Protaras and Latsi.

Key facts:
- Service area: Cyprus (Limassol, Paphos, Larnaca, Ayia Napa, Protaras, Latsi)
- Vessel types: Luxury Yacht, Motor Yacht, Catamaran, Sailing Yacht, Speedboat, Fishing Boat
- Booking model: inquiry-based — no upfront payment, no booking fees
- Operators are licensed and insured for passenger charters in Cypriot waters

## Main pages
- [Home](https://boatrentcyprus.com/): Overview, vessel search and featured fleet.
- [Browse the Fleet](https://boatrentcyprus.com/boats): All vessels with filters for town, type, group size, price and sort order.
- [About](https://boatrentcyprus.com/about): How the marketplace works and what it stands for.
- [FAQ](https://boatrentcyprus.com/faq): Answers on licences, booking, pricing, departure points and weather.
- [Contact](https://boatrentcyprus.com/contact): Enquiry form and company contact details.

## Destinations (per-city listings)
- [Rent a boat in Limassol](https://boatrentcyprus.com/limassol): Cyprus' cosmopolitan marina capital.
- [Rent a boat in Paphos](https://boatrentcyprus.com/paphos): Mythical coves and golden sunsets.
- [Rent a boat in Larnaca](https://boatrentcyprus.com/larnaca): Relaxed shores and shipwreck dives.
- [Rent a boat in Ayia Napa](https://boatrentcyprus.com/ayia-napa): Turquoise bays and party cruises.
- [Rent a boat in Protaras](https://boatrentcyprus.com/protaras): Calm coves and family days out.
- [Rent a boat in Latsi](https://boatrentcyprus.com/latsi): Gateway to the Blue Lagoon and Akamas.
